column1: # A.8: every tool read of .githooks/pre-push, one row per read, and the prose of the header block generated from it. TAB-separated.
# A prose row: prose, the paragraph it belongs to (bound, own, lists; rows of one paragraph are joined in order), its text.
# A read row: kind, read, fact, case, key, class.
#   kind   gate= or own= (a judged_read tag, matched to the hook's tags by name) or outside (a read the census finds outside judged_read).

#   fact   the sibling fact that shows a whole answer, or why an empty or short exit-0 answer there refuses or publishes nothing: an own= row, and a gate= row whose reason is the safe side, begins "safe:"; an outside row names the report or advice line it serves (or, for the scanner's argument list, the log the scanner run is judged from).

#   case   <file>:<@test title substring>, one match in tests/pre-push-<file>.bats: the case that drives THIS read with a silent tool keyed on its own shape through a real push, asserts the tool fired, then asserts the refusal or the unpublished remote the fact claims.

#   key    an outside row's fixed substring of its read's own command line, matched to exactly one read the census finds outside judged_read (and each such read to exactly one key); - for a gate= or own= row.
#   class  the fact's kind (marker, count, size, listing, digits, status, answer) or the safe reason's (strict, join, backstop, transfer, disarm, probe, report).
# The header block between the hook's two marker lines is GENERATED from this file (tests/pre-push-reads-header.sh): edit this table, never those lines.

column2: bound
column3: The bound of each sibling fact, stated once: a marker AHEAD of an answer bounds its start alone and says nothing of its end, so wholeness needs a TAIL marker (the message log asks for one after the message, since round 8), a count (the diff's awk records the lines it printed) or a byte count (a tag capture against the object's size); the diff's git stage holds a head marker alone (the commit's own sha, asked for by --always in place of --no-commit-id), since git prints no tail for a diff, and its awk's count bounds the awk's stage (a log answering the marker and part of the message passed the rest unread; the round 7 refuter, 2026-09-23).

column2: bound
column3: And a read whose answer is its STATUS alone gates nothing where exit 0 is the PERMISSIVE verdict, since a silent tool exits 0: the chosen-address match runs no tool since round 8, and the ancestry of a pushed commit is read since round 8b2 as the commit git merge-base names, which must be the pushed commit itself (under --is-ancestor a git silent on it and on the commit listing published a middle commit's banned line through a real push of a ref update; 2026-09-23).

column2: own
column3: What stays own=, and why a tool silent there publishes nothing by itself: a read whose empty answer is the object's own, with no sibling fact to hold it against. Each such read's line below says why an empty or short exit-0 answer there refuses or publishes nothing, and its row in tests/pre-push-reads.tsv names the case that shows it with the tool silent through a real push.

column2: own
column3: The greps among them answer by their status alone (-q), and there exit 0 is the hit, the strict side; the chosen-address MATCH was a third such grep until round 8, where exit 0 was the PERMISSIVE verdict and a grep silent with exit 0 made every stamped address chosen, publishing a banned-domain stamp through a real push (the round 7 refuter, 2026-09-23).

column2: own
column3: A join over the scratch listings disarms one gate on another read when a tool is silent there, while the read it gates stands under its status and its other gates; two tools silent at once, a listing and its gate, are outside this guarantee.

column2: lists
column3: The paragraphs above and the two lists below are GENERATED from tests/pre-push-reads.tsv by tests/pre-push-reads-header.sh, one row per read of this file (its tag, its sibling fact or the reason an empty or short answer there is the safe side, marked safe, and the case that drives it with the tool silent through a real push); tests/pre-push-hook.bats fails when the lines between the two marker lines differ from the generator's output by a byte, when a judged_read tag has no row or a row no tag, when a read the census finds outside judged_read is matched by no row's key or by two, and when either list names anything but the tags of its kind, so none of it is written by hand (round 5 found six reads of the second class the hand-written list had missed, each shown by a real push publishing a banned line with nothing printed; 2026-09-22).
